column2: @@EN@@ The internet went down.\nThe counter didn't.

@@EN@@ Kumkaj is the brand for concrete business operating system apps — complete business management software that runs on your own devices. Each product is built for one trade: courier, restaurant, grocery, pharmacy.
@@EN@@ Nothing on this counter waits for the cloud.
@@EN@@ Scroll or use the dots to jump between sections.
@@EN@@ A desk for each trade.\nNot one app with a switch.
@@EN@@ Not one app with a trade switch. Each product is designed around one kind of counter, in that trade's own words.
@@EN@@ COURIER OFFICES · FRANCHISE COUNTERS · OWN RIDERS
@@EN@@ Book → label → hand over → track → settle.
@@EN@@ Actual or volumetric weight, rounded your way
@@EN@@ Rider cash on delivery: expected against handed in
@@EN@@ Every table's minutes and bill at a glance
@@EN@@ One KOT per kitchen station — never prices
@@EN@@ Cash, UPI, part payment, Due and tip
@@EN@@ Fast counter sell with short codes
@@EN@@ Batch and expiry alerts on purchases
@@EN@@ Owner Schedule H / Rx notes — not fake compliance
@@EN@@ Your books live in your shop.
@@EN@@ Sales, parties and the day book are written on the device at your counter — not on a server you rent.
@@EN@@ Every sale, payment and docket is saved on the computer or tablet you own.
@@EN@@ Install it and start. No sign-up, no card on file.
@@EN@@ Save a backup copy whenever you like. It is a file, and it is yours.
@@EN@@ Extra counters and tablets join over your own Wi-Fi — with no internet in between.
@@EN@@ Pull the plug on the internet.
@@EN@@ Kumkaj apps don't phone home to work. Cut the internet and watch what changes at the counter.
@@EN@@ Book a parcel or take an order
@@EN@@ The internet is on — and the counter isn't using it.
@@EN@@ Things that leave the shop, like a WhatsApp receipt, still need the internet to arrive.
@@EN@@ No charge per seat, user, table, rider, parcel or local device. Not a trial.
@@EN@@ Pay only for what you use — the same rates for everyone.
@@EN@@ Cloud is planned and optional. The counter works without it.
@@EN@@ The same 115-language catalogue as every Kumkaj app — Arabic and Urdu right to left. Native names below; “Food ready” samples for Hindi, Gujarati, Tamil, Bengali, Urdu, and English:
@@EN@@ Same shaping engine as the apps, so joined letters and right-to-left lines come out right.
@@EN@@ Courier desk — book, label, hand over, settle.
@@EN@@ Restaurant system — table, kitchen, bill, day close.
@@EN@@ Grocery counter — sell, khata, stock, day book.
@@EN@@ Pharmacy counter — batch, expiry, bill, day close.
@@EN@@ Internet off — and nothing on the counter changed.
@@EN@@ Each Kumkaj product has its own account (and its own cloud). Choose the trade you run — sign-in and checkout stay on that product site.

@@EN@@ Yearly cloud plans — same five shapes for every trade (Free forever, Steady ₹6,000, Swift ₹12,000, Priority ₹24,000 / year ex-tax, or Custom quote). Tax is added at checkout. Each product keeps its own shop and account.
